summary: I checked the sandbox myself. The evening now stays lit and goes golden and then dark (18:24 and 19:36 screenshots). At 17:30 Sprout starts its sunset goal, and two friends walk to the lookout bench at 18:24. Frame median is 2.1 ms. But four host-suite tests failed and the author did not look into them.

findings.what: The host suite has four unexplained failures: the two sunset-bench tests (Sprout did not set off at 17.6 h with goal 'tend'; nobody sat within 60 s of 17:36), ball play (a fetcher chases after Stop) and Jump-in (Play did not start the berry race). The game itself looks fine for the bench: after skip_to_hour!(17.5) Sprout went to goal :sunset, and at 18:24 the panel shows Cumulus and Sir Sniffsalot 'off to the lookout bench'. So the bench tests may be stale against the new light and clock. That is unproven, and the two other failures are not explained at all.
findings.evidence: reviews/s54-1824.png (panel lists two friends heading to the bench); my own live_eval at 17.5 h showed Sprout :sunset then :idle
findings.suggestion: Run the four tests alone and in the suite. Adjust the bench tests to the new light_phase timing if they are stale. Print state in the check messages for ball play and Jump-in. Do not leave them red.

findings.what: At 19:36 the island is already quite dark and close to night, although the sunset sun is meant to last until 19.9. The look is atmospheric, but the screenshot is murky: the grass is almost black, and only glowing motes and the lamp pool are readable.
findings.evidence: reviews/s54-1936.png vs reviews/s54-1824.png (18:24 is bright, warm and long-shadowed)
findings.suggestion: If the golden hour should last, ease night_factor in more slowly between 19:00 and 19:45.

findings.what: I did not check the workshop corner or the berry race in the running game myself, only through the author's evidence and the panel text ('workshop corner is complete'). The first-play race win rate is still not guaranteed: the author's own runs show a loss in 1 of 4 before the last fix, and the last three runs were all won.
findings.evidence: author's journal runs 10-4, 8-6, 9-5; not re-run by me
findings.suggestion: Keep the W/A/D first-play test in the suite and watch it over the next sessions.

response: s55: all four host-suite failures pass when run in the sandbox now (lookout bench 9.7 s, sunset bench at dusk, ball play, jump-in camera menu). The suite ran while session 54's plugin edits were reloading (the sandbox log shows berry_race and workshop failing to load and a BerryRace BoundsError from a half-reloaded race), which explains the jump-in and likely the bench ones. The checks now print the state they saw (Sprout's goal/action, garden next_tend, lookout day, menu selection) so a repeat names its cause. The dusk-at-19:36 darkness and the race win rate stay with todos #237 and the berry race tests.
